datasets.title: Ethiopia Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2020
datasets.description: Ethiopia Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2020. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/ethiopia_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2020]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly basis throughout 2020 across Ethiopia. The classifications were spatially mapped to geographic units and compiled into monthly GeoJSON and KML files representing the current food insecurity situation. IPC classifications serve as post-event or ongoing impact assessments of food insecurity driven by drought and other hazards.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity severity across geographic areas.
